summary: Iteration 3 verified the HIGH-severity auth-crash fix from iteration 2. Fix lives in /app/frontend/src/api.js request() — it now coerces json.detail into a string (Array.isArray -> join .msg fields; object -> .msg or JSON.stringify; else raw). Verified end-to-end on mobile viewport 390x844: invalid-email signup (422 list detail), short-password signup (400 string detail), and 401 login all render as readable strings inside testID='auth-error' with no React red-screen. All 3 previous user-bug regressions (genre single-row, profile→/avatar-builder, gems USD→INR) still pass. Backend contract validated with 3 new pytest cases (all pass).

rca_of_issue: Root cause was renderer-side: FastAPI's default RequestValidationError serializer emits `detail` as `List[Dict]`, but the client threw with `err.detail = json.detail` and the UI passed that through <Text>{err}</Text>. React refuses non-primitive children. Fix (verified): centralize normalization at the fetch boundary in api.js so the Error always carries a string .detail. This is preferable to per-screen try/catch coercion because it covers all future screens too.
